review:
Book of Tut Megaways puts John Hunter's Egyptian adventure on a six-reel Megaways grid with up to 117,649 ways. A wild substitutes for base-game symbols, and in any spin a random symbol can be selected to expand across reels at the end of the spin, giving the base game more impact than most book slots.

Three or more scatters award 10 free spins with a fixed expanding symbol for the whole round, and three more scatters retrigger 10 extra spins. An ante bet can raise your chance of entering the bonus. The advertised maximum is 10,000x. The default RTP is 96%, below the studio's usual top setting, so check your casino's version.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
